messages.text: Your cookware set order is marked as shipped, not delivered, so it can’t be refunded through this process yet. Cancelling an order or changing its delivery is outside the refund process. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders)
What can I do to get a refund once it arrives?

Once the order is delivered, the cookware set must also be returned and recorded as received by the shop before you can request a refund. Then you can request a refund for the item, subject to the 30-day limit from the recorded delivery time. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)
